name: New Guinea Coastal Current
scope: Declared 146 E to 142 E offshore north-New-Guinea surface reference reach, ordered northwestward for the trade-wind convention. Both gates and every vertex are selected by OSW. Excludes southeast coastal continuation, Vitiaz Strait, Halmahera branches and the deeper New Guinea Coastal Undercurrent; not a whole-current endpoint or observed axis.
layer: Near-surface circulation schematic only; no fixed-depth slab, velocity core or undercurrent axis extracted.
time_convention: Figure 8.6 depicts April-November trade-wind circulation; December-March northwest monsoon reverses the surface flow. This editorial sketch is not dated geometry or a monthly climatological axis. The year-round northwest flow below 200 m is excluded.
source_locator: Chapter 8, Figure 8.6 / printed p111 (PDF121); printed pp125-126 (PDF135-136). Chapter version 1.1 March 2005. Figure and cited discussion visually inspected.
source_citation: Tomczak, M. and J.S. Godfrey, Regional Oceanography: An Introduction (1994), university-hosted online compilation, chapter versions stated separately.
source_license: No redistribution license established; original retained locally and ignored. Paraphrased factual annotations and independent OSW vertices only; no original image or curve copied.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects offshore regional gates and rounded vertices within the described geography. Alternative shapes shift intermediate latitudes by +/- 0.2 degree; longitude and independent endpoint-latitude shifts test drawing convention. These choices are not measured current boundaries, physical uncertainty or seasonal extrema.

scenario_rule: Three declared shapes crossed with three uniform longitude shifts and independent three-value endpoint latitude shifts: 81 retained editorial scenarios, not confidence limits or seasonal ranges.
remaining_gates: Independently review identity, layer, selected gates and fine coastline/bathymetry before physical admission.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
